name: Sasha Ivanov
source:
Adopted into the Ivanov family, Sasha uses his charisma and wit to seamlessly enter circles from all walks of life in Grey City.
Beneath his impressively bright personality in an otherwise shadowy world, however, lies someone with plenty of demons himself.
